exposure: neonates with and without early-onset sepsis
finding: This study identified 26 potential clinical risk factors for neonatal early-onset sepsis, including birth weight, one-minute Apgar score, prematurity, maternal gestational age, urinary tract infection, premature rupture of membranes, chorioamnionitis, and intrapartum fever.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was not found to be a significant risk factor for early-onset sepsis.
birth_weight: birth weight was included in the analysis
